ui_usage_cached: summary wey dem save, no new use
ui_usage_cost_note: Di cost na estimate: wetin dis tokens go cost if you use di provider API for list price. E no be wetin you dey pay; subscription no dey charge you for every request.
ui_idle_hint: Click di extension icon make e summarize dis page.
ui_truncated: Dis page long well well; na only di first part we summarize.
error_page_unreadable: We no fit read dis page. Browser pages and di Chrome Web Store no dey work here.
error_no_content: We no see any article text for dis page.
error_needs_click: Click di extension icon make e summarize dis page. After di tab don comot go anoda page, di extension need new click before e fit read am.
error_host_missing: Di local component no dey installed or e no dey answer. For di extension folder, run: ./native-host/install.sh
error_claude_missing: We no see Claude Code. Install am, then run ./native-host/install.sh again.
error_claude_auth: You never log in for Claude Code. Run claude for terminal and log in.
error_codex_signed_out: You never log in for Codex. Run codex login for terminal.
error_codex_not_eligible: Your ChatGPT plan no fit work for dis one. Choose anoda provider.
error_usage_limit: You don reach di usage limit for your plan. Try again later or choose anoda provider.
error_provider_failed: Di provider fail as e dey write di summary. Try again.
error_codex_missing: We no see Codex. Install am, then run ./native-host/install.sh again.
options_help: Summary dey pass through di local component for dis computer: e dey run Claude Code or Codex with your subscription, or one model for Ollama. Na only di provider wey you choose we dey send di page text go.
error_ollama_missing: Ollama no dey run for dis computer. Install am from ollama.com and open am, then try again.
error_ollama_model_missing: Dis model never download for Ollama. Run ollama pull with di model name (for example, ollama pull llama3.2), then try again.
options_models_checked: We read di model lists for {date}.
options_models_never: We never read di model lists yet.
options_models_auto: Dem dey come from Claude Code, Codex and Ollama, and we dey read dem again once every day, when Claude Code or Codex update, and when di extension update.
error_file_access: To summarize files wey dey dis computer, open di extension Details for chrome://extensions and on Allow access to file URLs.
error_pdf_unreadable: We no fit open dis PDF. E fit get password wey dey protect am, or e don spoil.
error_pdf_no_text: Dis PDF no get text wey we fit summarize. E fit be say na scanned pictures dem take make am.
history_empty: No summary dey yet. Dem go show here as you dey make dem.
history_clear_confirm: Click again make e delete everything
options_history: Keep history of summaries (for dis computer)
error_no_transcript: Dis video no get transcript wey we fit summarize. YouTube go only get am if di video get subtitles or automatic captions.
options_styles_help: Style dey add instruction to di summary, for example: Summarize am like thread of three short posts.
